title: [Feature]Huggingface is not mentioned in the provider list but in documentation page also mentioned it as a provider
body:
### Description

In the documentation page you have clearly mentioned about the llm [LLMs
](https://docs.crewai.com/concepts/llms#hugging-face) support for crew projects.But when we try to create a crew in the providers list i couldnt see HUggingface anywhere.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad5bee3c-c48d-4be9-a415-356e7739f0f8)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db018e1a-9cc0-4e6f-ab38-40f60dee5f81)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c416a914-c4e3-4c8d-a635-7c2c8f687bcb)

### Steps to Reproduce

In console,
1.crewai create crew x_crew
2.You can see top 12  providers list,you cant see huggingface there,so 12th option Others is selected
3.Another window will pop up,In that also i couldnt see any such options 


### Expected behavior

It will be much helpful if huggingface is also there as a provider.

### Screenshots/Code snippets

Sure

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a656bfba-41fa-47a9-a3ce-5b617ad3f210)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/881fd193-92fa-4e7e-bf0f-c0a797be6e18)

### Operating System

Ubuntu 22.04

### Python Version

3.10

### crewAI Version

0.108.0

### crewAI Tools Version

0.40.1

### Virtual Environment

Conda

### Evidence

Already shared

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/acaa01c3-75dd-4eb6-aaf3-15edc7ec08ff)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d419862e-38fb-4848-938c-4b1e739b9aa3)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ae06b5a4-ce04-423a-9d2f-3b551903c7c3)

### Possible Solution

Include Huggingface also in the providers list if possible,Atleast llama ,phi,like models can be utilised in diverse projects.

### Additional context

None

linked_prs.title: Fix #2551: Add Huggingface to provider list in CLI
linked_prs.body:
This PR fixes issue #2551 by adding Huggingface to the provider list in the CLI.

### Changes:
- Added Huggingface to the `PROVIDERS` list
- Added Huggingface environment variables configuration
- Added Huggingface models to the `MODELS` dictionary
- Added tests to verify the changes

Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/47cc5ca0b5aa4726a75c7e9271d24831
Requested by: Joe Moura (joao@crewai.com)

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

Explanation: The issue explicitly references an LLM provider (Huggingface) missing from the agent system's provider list, which prevents its use for agent tasks. This aligns with "Unsupported models" and "Incompatibility with LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.
